verdict.rationale: Vue's official testing guide says composables that use only Reactivity APIs can be tested by calling them directly and asserting on their returned state and methods, with a useCounter example that renders no DOM. It also recommends Vitest, maintained by Vue/Vite team members, as the unit runner for headless composables. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of DOM-free reactive state testing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit test my reactive state and logic without needing to render the DOM

citations.quote: If a composable only uses Reactivity APIs, then it can be tested by directly invoking it and asserting its returned state/methods
Vitest for components or composables that render headlessly (e.g. the useFavicon function in VueUse).
Vitest is a unit testing framework designed specifically for this purpose, created and maintained by Vue / Vite team members.
